title: quickstart
body: Lunaris quickstart: how to install, open a handle, and ingest your first Episode into the knowledge base.

title: architecture
body: Architecture overview of the Lunaris memory engine: Moon plus Postgres dual backends, bi-temporal MVCC, graph opt-in.

title: ingest path
body: Ingest path walks the Episode through chunker, embedder, and atomic write into storage.

title: recall DSL
body: Recall DSL composes Vector, Keyword, and Graph operators into a reciprocal rank fusion pipeline.

title: graph pipeline
body: The graph pipeline is opt-in per blueprint section 5.2 and defaults off at runtime.

title: consolidator
body: The consolidator worker promotes notes to Facts via ACT-R base-level scoring.

title: verifier
body: The verifier uses a slower model to arbitrate contradictions in the background queue.

title: forget
body: Forget is the single-entry erasure API. Soft delete by default; hard mode requires a confirmation token.

title: protocol
body: MemoryProtocol publishes the portable wire interface so agents do not lock to one memory engine.

title: recipes
body: Recipes compose four primitives: MessageStream, DocumentCorpus, TemporalQuery, and WorkingMemory.

title: helios
body: Helios is the named v0 consumer. HeliosScratchpad wires Read, Write, Edit, and Grep onto bi-temporal Episodes.

title: hot path
body: Hot path latency budget targets a sub-25 millisecond recall over millions of bi-temporal facts.

title: embedder
body: The EmbeddingGemma 768 dimensional embedder is the default; swappable via the Embedder trait.

title: chunker
body: Markdown chunker splits at 500 token boundaries with 100 token overlap and heading path annotations.

title: bm25
body: BM25 keyword operator runs via Moon FT.AGGREGATE or Postgres tsvector depending on backend.

title: vector search
body: Vector search runs via Moon HNSW TurboQuant or Postgres pgvector.

title: reranker
body: BGE reranker v2 m3 cross encoder adds 12 millisecond rerank stage to the recall budget.

title: snapshot
body: Snapshot returns the current monotonic LSN as a cheap consistent marker via no-op atomic write.

title: audit
body: Audit events flow to the __lunaris_audit__ partition with typed publish_audit_event.

title: queue
body: Durable queue backs the verify and consolidate workers with at-least-once delivery and DLQ.

title: quickstart python
body: Quickstart for Python: pip install lunaris then import and call await lunaris.open.

title: quickstart typescript
body: Quickstart for TypeScript: npm install lunaris then import open and call with a URL.

title: quickstart rust
body: Quickstart for Rust: add lunaris to Cargo.toml then use Lunaris::open with a moon or postgres URL.

title: deployment docker
body: Deployment reference image ships the lunaris-server binary with a single config file.

title: deployment embed
body: Embedded Lunaris::open handle runs in process with graph-off default and query-string opt-in.

title: deployment sidecar
body: Sidecar lunaris-server ships four MemoryProtocol verbs over axum 0.8 with Bearer auth.

title: observability
body: Observability spans follow tracing conventions lunaris.subsystem.op across seven entry points.

title: metrics
body: Prometheus metrics expose queue depth, ingest latency, recall latency, and degraded-hit counters.

title: conformance
body: The lunaris-conformance crate bundles the storage and protocol suite for downstream backends.

title: test harness
body: Test harness reuses FixtureCorpus across Moon and Postgres so parity covers both backends at once.

title: chunks index
body: Chunks index carries valid_time numeric field for the TemporalQuery between range renderer.

title: valid time
body: Valid time range renders as @valid_time:[lo hi] on Moon and valid_from between clauses on Postgres.

title: as of
body: As of snapshots are backed by TEMPORAL.SNAPSHOT_AT on Moon and bi-temporal columns on Postgres.

title: episodes
body: Episodes carry an HLC wall timestamp, a counter, a node id, and a source string identifier.

title: chunks
body: Chunks derive from markdown splitting; each chunk carries metadata inherited from its Episode.

title: entities
body: Entities are extracted by the Gemma 3 4B extractor under a strict GBNF grammar.

title: relations
body: Relations connect entities with bi-temporal validity; edges drop into the Moon GRAPH or Postgres AGE.

title: facts
body: Facts carry a subject, predicate, object triple plus provenance and bi-temporal bounds.

title: communities
body: Communities emerge from label propagation Leiden on the entity graph; v2 extends to hierarchical Leiden.

title: rrf
body: Reciprocal rank fusion with k equals 60 is the default fuser across Vector and Keyword branches.

title: filter startswith
body: Filter StartsWith on the source column scopes recall to a single recipe's namespace.

title: filter eq
body: Filter Eq on metadata fields narrows recall to a specific user, thread, or attendee.

title: filter range
body: Filter ValidTimeRange targets the bi-temporal valid-from column with lower-inclusive and upper-exclusive bounds.

title: hlc
body: HLC is a hybrid logical clock carrying wall milliseconds, a counter, and a node id.

title: lsn
body: LSN is a monotonic storage-layer sequence number returned from atomic_write.

title: storage port
body: StoragePort is the trait that MoonStorage and PostgresStorage both implement.

title: conformance chaos
body: Chaos property test SIGKILLs the process mid-atomic-write and asserts zero orphan rows on recovery.

title: eval gauntlet
body: Eval gauntlet runs LongMemEval, LoCoMo, and ER F1 on every push and gates merges on thresholds.

title: multi tenant
body: Workspaces give per-tenant key prefixing so multi-tenant isolation is transparent at the storage layer.

title: quickstart cheatsheet
body: Quickstart cheatsheet covers install, open, ingest, recall, and forget in under 30 lines of code.
